articles.summary: CORAL GABLES, Fla. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 10, 2026-- MasTec, Inc. (NYSE: MTZ) today announced the appointment of Ati Modak as Vice President of Investor Relations, effective September 2026. Mr. Modak joins MasTec from Goldman Sachs, where he served as Vice President, Equity Research, Energy
articles.title: MasTec Announces the Appointment of Ati Modak as Vice President of Investor Relations
